Class ControllerLessonDelete

java.lang.Object
guiLessonDelete.ControllerLessonDelete
public final class ControllerLessonDelete extends Object
KG07 deletion occurs only from the explicit Yes action. @author Kanish Garg *

Attributes and rationale: model is the persistence/validation boundary; view is the current window whose draft and status are updated. This separation follows Foundations MVC and the Kanish Garg GUI assignment in TP2 Work Split. Controllers do not store a SQL connection, edit the authenticated identity, or modify another member's data implementation.
